title: Jesus... I Said I Forgive Him So Why Does It Still Hurt?
topic: said she forgave him but the hurt keeps returning every night

bible.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I smiled when I said it. But every night it plays again. 💔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It wasn't fake. Forgiveness is a decision you keep making while the feeling catches up.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: How many times do I have to forgive the same thing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: As many times as it returns. Not for him. So your heart stops carrying him.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hand it to Me again tonight. I never tire of holding it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who forgave but still hurts. 💔
